name: Nanaka
source:
Nanaka is a mysterious girl who wears a school uniform different from that of Gunjo Academy. She always appears or disappears suddenly in front of [url=https://vndb.org/c3658]Taichi[/url] without any warning, usually by violently crashing into him while she is on her bike. [spoiler]Taichi realizes later that Nanaka is actually a ghost of his dead mother that he never met.[/spoiler]

[Edited from [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cross_Channel_%28visual_novel%29]Wikipedia[/url]]
